article.hook: You notice the cracks others overlook. The urge to dig into details isn’t nagging - it’s relentless. Pluto in Virgo is rewriting the rules of usefulness by tearing down what’s useless first.
article.lived: Pluto takes about twenty years to cross Virgo, shaping a generation wired to transform through precision. You see it when someone rewires a workflow until it hums or dissects a problem so thoroughly they unearth what’s been bleeding time and energy for years. The change isn’t flashy; it’s surgical, the slow burn of cutting out rot beneath the surface of everyday tasks and systems.
article.turn: That sharp eye can turn into obsession. When every flaw demands correction, people shrink under scrutiny or snap at the slightest imperfection. Control becomes a cage - holding things so tightly that nothing can breathe, adapt, or grow. Perfection becomes paralysis, and usefulness curdles into judgment you can’t turn off.
moves: Pick one routine task and redesign it with ruthless efficiency this week.
Speak up the exact fix when you see something broken, no matter how small.
Set a strict time limit for edits - stop before you break what’s working.
